text: I'm living with my aunt this year.
note: Present continuous for a temporary arrangement: natural in context.

text: Bring your dictionary to class tomorrow.
note: Natural when the speaker is at school; take when not.

text: I'll come to your party on Friday.
note: Come towards the listener's place: natural.
Some in a question can be natural, especially when expecting yes.

text: Look at the TV, it's on fire!
note: Look at, not watch, because it is about seeing it now.

text: I have a little time after lunch.
note: A little with an uncountable noun: natural.

text: We go to the park on Fridays.
Can you make me a cup of tea?
